summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue ex-gold sales up 76% to INR239 crore; EBITDA up 103% to INR63 crore at 26.3% margin.
summary.overview: PNGS Reva reported Q2 FY27 revenue of INR121 crore, up 17% YoY on a reported basis but up about 46% when excluding last year's B2B gold scrap sales. Gross margin expanded to 31.1% in Q2 (from 24.2%) and 33.2% in H1 (from 26.7%). Q2 EBITDA was INR29 crore at a 23.8% margin, and H1 PAT was INR51 crore, up 151% YoY. Management said Q3 started strongly, with Navaratri-plus-Dussehra sales up 35% and the Dussehra day up 62%, and guided H2 broadly in line with H1, while flagging drought in Maharashtra and inflation as risks.

segments.name: SIS stores (existing format)
segments.commentary: Management said 95%-plus of current revenue comes from SIS stores; it expects at least 35-40% SSG from SIS in H2, and noted H1 growth was mainly from SIS.

segments.name: EBO / COCO stores
segments.commentary: Six EBOs now operating (Wakad, Paud Road, Amanora Mall, Nashik, Jaipur, Bavdhan). Wakad did about INR6.5 crore in its first year; target is INR9-10 crore per store per year after 15-18 months.

segments.name: E-commerce (revadiamonds.com)
segments.commentary: Launched in FY27 as a catalogue and visibility channel; management said online sales will not be sizable.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27 expected to be in line with H1; management expects good full-year numbers.
Q3 FY27 started strongly: Navaratri 10-day sales up 35% and Dussehra day sales up 62% YoY.
Management guided to 40-45% growth for H2 FY27, cautioning on Maharashtra drought (85%-plus of state) and West Asia-driven inflation.
Full-year revenue split of roughly 45-55 or 50-50 between H1 and H2, versus the usual 35:65 pattern, as Gudi Padwa sales fall in H2 this year.
EBITDA margin may see about plus or minus 200 bps pressure from EBO pre-opening marketing costs; 15 EBOs targeted within 24 months of the IPO, with at least three more expected in H2 FY27.
EBOs expected to contribute meaningfully from Q4 FY28 after 15-18 months.
capex_capacity: Store formats: about 1,000 sq ft (small), 1,200 sq ft (medium) and 1,500 sq ft (large); the next 15 EBOs are planned as 5 of each.
Capex per EBO: INR2-2.5 crore infrastructure plus INR2-2.5 crore initial marketing; inventory INR10-12 crore (1,000 sq ft), INR12-15 crore (1,200 sq ft), INR15-18 crore (1,500 sq ft).
Premises are leased; six months' rent deposit of about INR30-40 lakh per store at INR300-700 per sq ft rent.
Of the 15 EBOs planned, about 6 are done; the remaining 9 are expected within 18-20 months, ahead of schedule, funded from the IPO proceeds.
Outside Maharashtra, new stores will be mall-based; Jaipur was the first store outside Maharashtra.
demand_pricing: Volume growth in Q2: about 28% on diamond-stone sale basis; gold value up about 57%, of which about 20% was rate appreciation.
Average selling price (per invoice/customer) about INR1,05,000-1,07,000, versus INR92,000 last year; growth attributed to higher inventory of fast-moving price points.
Order mix: custom job-work orders are not more than 30%; 70%-plus is ready stock from showrooms. Company describes itself as B2C-only for jewellery.
Gold price has corrected about 25%; management expects no inventory gain in H2 and no sales lift from higher gold prices.
Lab-grown diamonds: management says solitaires are only 4-5% of the book, and LGD poses no direct threat to the 95% design book; no plans to enter LGD for now.
Buy-back on natural diamond purchased from its stores at 90%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the split between job work and own manufacturing, and what is volume growth in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Custom orders are not more than 30% of sales, with 70%-plus from ready showroom stock. Q2 volume growth was about 28% on diamond-stone basis and about 57% on gold value, of which about 20% was rate appreciation.

qa_highlights.question: Are the EBITDA margins of around 26% sustainable for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EBO pre-opening marketing costs may move margins by plus or minus 200 bps; EBOs will contribute only after 15-18 months.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capex per EBO and the outlook by format?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex is about INR4-5 crore excluding inventory, plus INR10-18 crore of inventory depending on size; rent deposit about INR30-40 lakh per store.

qa_highlights.question: What is the SSG outlook for H2 and FY28 given gold price correction?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects no gold-appreciation support in H2; SIS SSG target at least 35-40%; management said FY28 is too far to predict, and EBOs contribute from Q4 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Will H2 revenue be about 65% of the year, and can full-year revenue reach INR700 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the usual 35:65 split may not hold this year, with a possible 45-55 or 50-50 split due to drought and inflation; it said it does not expect INR800 crore revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Will the INR2 crore store marketing spend be capitalised?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said under Ind AS it cannot be capitalised and will be expensed directly in P&L; spend tapers over 12-18 months after opening.

risks_watch: Maharashtra drought (85%-plus of state under drought, per management) could weigh on festive and H2 demand.
Inflation and West Asia-related pressures may affect consumer sentiment and sales.
EBO ramp-up: 9 of 15 EBOs still to open; pre-opening marketing costs can hit EBITDA margin by about 200 bps.
Gold price correction (about 25%) removes inventory gains and gold-price support to growth.
Management declined to give precise quantification on several questions, and said FY28 is too far out to forecast.
summary.management_tone: Confident on Q2 and H1 delivery and festive momentum, but notably cautious on H2 and FY28, repeatedly qualifying guidance with drought, inflation and West Asia risks. Management was also reluctant to give precise numbers, framing answers in relative or industry terms.
key_quotes: Our COCO stores are performing in line with expectations and we remain focused on the expanding of our retail footprint through quality location and delivering the superior customer experience.
Generally, in this kind of industry where pure gold, natural diamonds, certified diamond and all these things are getting traded, there is a limited scope for the online sale.
So I expect that around 40%, 45% kind of the growth I'm expecting. But again, as I said, severity should not increase, which is there at present.

growth.why: Management guides H2 FY27 sales growth of 40-45% (midpoint ~42.5%), backed by SIS SSG of 35-40% and at least 3 more EBOs in H2 with 9 of 15 planned EBOs still to open within 18-20 months, but the call gives no order book figures and flags Maharashtra drought and inflation as risks.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 26.3% (vs 19.6%) and gross margin 33.2%, but EBO pre-opening marketing may move margins by plus or minus 200 bps and no gold inventory gains are expected in H2.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 6 of 15 planned EBOs are open; at least 3 more are expected in H2 FY27 and the remaining 9 within 18-20 months, funded from IPO proceeds.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides H2 FY27 sales growth of 40-45% with SIS SSG of at least 35-40%; Q2 volume grew about 28% on a diamond-stone basis and Q3 Navaratri-plus-Dussehra sales were up 35%.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex is funded by IPO proceeds for the remaining 9 EBOs, with about INR2-2.5 crore infrastructure plus INR10-18 crore inventory per store, but no new capex programme beyond the EBO rollout was announced and utilisation was not discussed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management guided H2 broadly in line with H1 and 40-45% growth, and said it does not expect INR800 crore full-year revenue, which points against a raise despite a strong Q3 start.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Maharashtra drought affects over 85% of the state, West Asia-driven inflation is a risk, and the full-year revenue split may move to 45-55 or 50-50 instead of the usual 35:65.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new product or brand launches were discussed; the call covered EBO store rollout only, with e-commerce described as not sizable and no LGD entry planned.

rows.label: Mall-based EBO expansion outside Maharashtra
rows.why: Jaipur is the first store outside Maharashtra, and new non-Maharashtra stores will be mall-based, with at least 3 more EBOs expected in H2 FY27.

rows.label: Inventory build for new EBOs
rows.why: Each EBO needs INR10-18 crore of inventory depending on size, so 9 more stores imply roughly INR90-160 crore of inventory funded from IPO proceeds.

rows.label: Higher average ticket size
rows.why: Average invoice rose to about INR1,05,000-1,07,000 from INR92,000 last year, but gold has corrected about 25%, so no gold-price lift is expected in H2.

tone.note: Management was confident on Q2 and H1 delivery and festive momentum, and on the EBO rollout ahead of schedule, but cautious on H2 and FY28 with drought, inflation and West Asia risks.
